segments.ja: ニコロは、島で料理を続けるマーレの料理人です。続ける理由の半分は、サシャが彼の皿を本気で喜んだ、です。喜んだ人がいない今日も、彼は兵団の客に席を出します。出す席に、カヤの家族と、見知らぬ二人の子供が来ます。来る子供は、ガビとファルコです。です。ニコロは、二人の顔をまだ船の一発とは結びません。結ばないまま、彼は汁と、肉と、パンを並べます。
segments.en: Niccolo is a cook from Marley who keeps cooking on the island. Half the reason he keeps going is that Sasha truly enjoyed his plates. Even on a day the person who enjoyed them is gone, he sets seats for the corps' guests. Kaya's family and two unknown children come to the seats he sets. The children who come are Gabi and Falco. They are. Niccolo does not yet tie the two faces to the one shot on the ship. Without tying them, he lines up soup, meat, and bread.

segments.en: Kaya brings the two she picked up on the road to the family's meal. The reason she brings them is that this seat looked safer than the village bedding. Gabi still thinks the safety that looked so is an enemy's house. The eyes that think that hear Sasha's name inside the talk of cooking. The name they hear comes out of Niccolo's mouth again and again. Each time it comes out, Gabi's back goes stiff. Beside the stiffness, Falco looks at Kaya's hand.

segments.ja: ニコロは、サシャが肉を大きい音で食べたことを話します。話す声は、怒りではなく、喪失です。喪失を、カヤの家族は自分の家の穴として聞きます。聞く穴は、女の兵士が村からいなくなった、です。いなくなった人と、ニコロの皿が同じ名で結ばれます。結ばれる席で、ガビは自分がその名を止めた側だと知っています。知っていることを、彼女はまだ言いません。言わない沈黙が、料理の湯気の中で目立ちます。
segments.en: Niccolo talks about Sasha eating meat with a large sound. The voice that talks is not anger. It is loss. Kaya's family hears the loss as a hole in their own house. The hole they hear is that the woman soldier left the village. The person who left and Niccolo's plate are tied by the same name. At the seat where they are tied, Gabi knows she is on the side that stopped that name. She does not yet say what she knows. The silence of not saying it stands out inside the steam of the cooking.

segments.en: At the edge of the seats, a soldier makes the bottles on Niccolo's shelf a topic. The topic he makes is that superiors are drinking the wine the volunteers distributed. One of the places they are drinking is the forest. In the forest, Levi is avoiding the same bottles while watching Zeke. The reason he is avoiding them is that he does not trust the wine under the smile. The trust he does not makes a single line between today's dining room and the forest. Gabi does not know the line that connects them.
